thread:
elaine: Heads-up: I want to harmonize a couple small things across docs. We have mixed use of `model` vs `model_name` in examples and inconsistent use of "latency" vs "response latency" in Observability pages. Proposing: consolidate public SDK examples to `model`, keep `model_name` for internal schema docs, and add a short glossary note explaining the choice.

mike: OK. I can patch JS + Python snippets. Leaning `model` tooit's cleaner in examples. I'll add an inline comment about legacy schemas.

samira: Agree with `model` for public-facing code. For infra docs that show DB schemas we should keep `model_name`. Also suggest we avoid using the word "deprecated" in examples until we have a formal deprecation announcement.

toni: I'll draft the glossary blurb. Suggest a single authoritative sentence plus a tiny style note: "Use concise, neutral definitions; avoid promotional language."

elaine: Perfect. Keep the glossary line prescriptive: e.g., "Use `model` in SDK examples; use `model_name` where schema clarity matters." Keep it neutral and short.

mike: Draft PR open: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/4723 - updates examples/js, examples/py, and examples/README. Snippets replaced like:

```js
// legacy: model_name is accepted for older schemas
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt });
```

```py
# legacy: model_name is accepted for older schemas
res = client.generate(model='redwood-1', prompt=prompt)
```

samira: Quick editorial: replace any instance of ambiguous "latency" with "response latency" where we mean end-to-end measurement. That's in the observability guide.

mike: Will do. Also adding a small CI lint in docs repo that flags mixed param names in examples to prevent regressions.

toni: Glossary PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/4724 - one-sentence rationale + style note. Added a changelog entry in docs/CHANGELOG.md. Wording: "Use `model` in public SDK examples for brevity; use `model_name` in schema or database contexts where field identity must be explicit."

elaine: Two pre-merge checks: assign docs ownership review to @samira and a quick tone pass by me. If both approve we'll merge today.

samira: Reviewing now. I'll focus on customer-facing wording and make sure we don't accidentally introduce "deprecated" in example comments.

docs-bot: PR 4723 build passed ✅

mike: Adjusted comments to say "legacy" not "deprecated" and added TODO with removal target 2026-06-30 in internal roadmap (not customer-facing). Also added tests that ensure examples contain either `model` or a legacy-commented `model_name`.

toni: Updated glossary wording to start with "Use" instead of "Prefer" so it's prescriptive for the style guide. Also linked to a short internal migration checklist.

elaine: Awesome. Samira, if your review is green, mike to merge; toni to merge glossary after changelog check. I'll post a short note in #release-notes once both are merged.

samira: LGTM with one tiny change: in sdk-params.md line ~18 change "latency" to "response latency". Making that patch now.

mike: Fine, merge once that's in.

docs-bot: PR 4723 merged by mike at 2460014022

toni: Merged PR 4724 and opened follow-up issue to review localized/regional docs for phrasing differences.

elaine: Closing the loop: added a line to the docs style checklist: "Verify SDK param naming parity in examples before merge" and filed a docs-tooling quick-win to add a pre-merge check. Thanks all :tada:
